cmd:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/classicbook.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Classic bot order book recorder
After=network-online.target

[Service]
WorkingDirectory=/opt/trading-bot/classic
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/trading-bot/classic/classic_book.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now classicbook && sleep 40 && systemctl is-active classicbook && python3 -c "import sqlite3;c=sqlite3.connect('/opt/trading-bot/classic/book.db');print(c.execute('select count(*),count(distinct sym) from snap').fetchone())"; journalctl -u classicbook -n 5 --no-pager | tail -5
